FN-U51KDDD-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 255
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/02/2024
Senate Bill 255 as introduced could increase the obligations of DOC by an estimated $84.50 per
day per parole violator held in a DOC facility beyond 20 days during a declared state of
emergency pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-U51KDDD-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 255
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/03/2024
Senate Bill 255 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary would increase the obligations of the
Department of Corrections (DOC), for parole violations held in custody beyond 20 days during
a declared state of emergency pursuant to the provisions of this bill, by an estimated $84.50 per
day per parole violator held in a DOC facility and by $28 per day per parole violator held in a
county jail, subject to concurrence with the sheriff.
Page 1

FN-U51KDDD-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 255
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 255 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Department of
Corrections (DOC) by an estimated $84.50 per day for each parole violators held in DOC
custody beyond 20 days during a declared state of emergency pursuant to the provisions of this
bill. This bill would also increase the obligations of the counties by an estimated $28 per day per
parole violator held in a county jail, subject to concurrence with the sheriff, during a state of
emergency pursuant to this bill.
